calls.title: Acorns + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The Acorns team discussed their ambition to significantly scale experimentation capabilities from the current 100 experiments primarily conducted by the growth team to a target of 10,000 as more teams get involved. They identified existing challenges, such as manual reporting bottlenecks and multiple data sources that complicate the establishment of a single source of truth for experiment metrics. To address these challenges, the discussion turned to potential solutions like GrowthBook, which offers an open-source platform designed for scalability and compliance with fintech regulations. Additionally, the team explored the use of generative AI to automate portions of the experimentation process, enhancing overall efficiency and shortening test lifecycles. The focus included ensuring that the platform supports deep analysis, customizable reporting, and provides a near-zero incremental cost model to encourage rapid testing.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Feature Flags, Open Source, Fintech, AI Enablement, Data Warehouse
